summary.text: Gull the Woodcutter is a Dominarian woodcutter and brother of Greensleeves who led a wizard-hunting army after his family was killed in the destruction of White Ridge.

bio.text: White Ridge was destroyed in a wizards' duel, killing Gull's parents and two siblings, and Gull pledged to kill any wizard he met.
Towser hired him as freightmaster, and Gull brought Greensleeves along, until Towser revealed he meant to kill her to store her power in the mana vault and teleported Gull away.
Summoned back by Lily, Gull fought Towser, and Greensleeves, revealed as a wizard, cast an earthquake and tsunami, after which the two built an army.
Gull married Lily, and in the Badlands the army defeated Haakon.
At Lat-Nam, Towser's wizards and a Keldon warlord attacked from three directions, and Gull realized the warlord was his lost brother Sparrow Hawk, and the brothers reconciled.
Haakon's fireball engulfed the brothers, and Greensleeves, mad with grief, was calmed by Kwam and poured her mana into Lat-Nam, then stripped Towser of his magic with the Stone Brain.

status.text: After Greensleeves was declared High Wizard of the Domains, she and her brothers vanished from history.
